examples.source: If you go to Robinson Road, you will see many tall buildings.
examples.target: 如果你去羅便臣道，你會看到很多高樓大廈。

examples.source: The robot can clean the floor when we are at school.
examples.target: 當我們在學校時，這部機械人可以幫忙清潔地板。

examples.source: My brother wants to build a robot for his science project.
examples.target: 我弟弟想為他的科學專題習作製作一個機械人。

examples.source: This robot is very helpful because it can carry heavy books.
examples.target: 這部機械人很有幫助，因為它能搬運沉重的書本。

examples.source: A hamster is a popular type of small rodent for pets.
examples.target: 倉鼠是一種受歡迎的小型齧齒動物寵物。

examples.source: The scientist studied the rodent to learn about its eating habits.
examples.target: 科學家研究那隻齧齒動物，以了解牠的飲食習慣。

examples.source: If you see a rodent in the house, you should tell your parents.
examples.target: 如果你在家裡看到齧齒動物，應該告訴你的父母。

examples.source: The ball started to roll down the hill when I kicked it.
examples.target: 當我踢球時，球就開始向山下滾動。

examples.source: Please roll the paper into a tube if you want to store it.
examples.target: 如果你想收藏那張紙，請將它捲成筒狀。

examples.source: Tears began to roll down her cheeks because she was very sad.
examples.target: 因為她很傷心，眼淚開始沿著面頰流下來。

examples.source: Please roll up your sleeves before you wash your hands.
examples.target: 洗手之前，請先捲起你的衣袖。

examples.source: You should roll up the sleeping bag after you wake up.
examples.target: 你起床後應該要把睡袋捲起來。

examples.source: I need to roll up this poster to put it away.
examples.target: 我需要把這張海報捲起來收好。

examples.source: Please pass me a roll of paper towels from the kitchen.
examples.target: 請遞給我一卷廚房紙巾。

examples.source: I bought a roll of tape to fix my broken poster.
examples.target: 我買了一卷膠紙來修補我破掉的海報。

examples.source: She used a roll of ribbon to wrap the birthday present.
examples.target: 她用了一卷絲帶去包裝這份生日禮物。

examples.source: They had a romantic dinner by the sea last night.
examples.target: 他們昨晚在海邊享用了一頓浪漫的晚餐。

examples.source: The movie is very romantic, so I really like it.
examples.target: 這部電影很浪漫，所以我非常喜歡。

examples.source: He wrote a romantic poem to show his love.
examples.target: 他寫了一首浪漫的詩來表達他的愛意。

examples.source: We need to find the root cause of this problem.
examples.target: 我們需要找出這個問題的根本原因。

examples.source: Stress is often the root cause of his headaches.
examples.target: 壓力往往是他頭痛的根本原因。

examples.source: If we identify the root cause, we can fix it.
examples.target: 如果我們找出根本原因，就能解決它。

examples.source: The boy used a long rope to tie up his boxes.
examples.target: 那個男孩用一條長繩子把他的箱子綁起來。

examples.source: Please hold the rope tightly if you want to climb up.
examples.target: 如果你想爬上去，請緊緊握住那條繩子。

examples.source: We need a strong rope to pull the heavy wooden boat.
examples.target: 我們需要一條堅固的繩子來拉動那艘重木船。

rose.meaning: rise 的過去式 / 上升了

examples.source: The water level rose quickly when the heavy rain started.
examples.target: 當大雨開始時，水位迅速上升。

examples.source: He rose from his chair to greet his teacher politely.
examples.target: 他從椅子上站起來，禮貌地迎接老師。

examples.source: The sun rose early on a clear summer morning.
examples.target: 在一個晴朗的夏日早晨，太陽很早就升起了。

examples.source: He bought a beautiful red rose for his mother on Mother's Day.
examples.target: 他在母親節買了一朵漂亮的紅玫瑰送給媽媽。

examples.source: The sweet scent of the rose filled the garden on a sunny morning.
examples.target: 陽光明媚的早晨，花園裡充滿了玫瑰的甜美香氣。

examples.source: She carefully placed a single rose in a glass vase on the desk.
examples.target: 她小心翼翼地把一朵玫瑰插在書桌上的玻璃花瓶裡。

examples.source: The apple in my bag has gone rotten.
examples.target: 我袋裡的蘋果已經腐爛了。

examples.source: Please throw away the rotten fruit in the kitchen.
examples.target: 請把廚房裡腐爛的水果丟掉。

examples.source: The smell of the rotten food was very bad.
examples.target: 腐爛食物的氣味很難聞。

examples.source: I have a rough idea of how to solve this problem.
examples.target: 我對如何解決這個問題有一個大約的概念。

examples.source: The teacher gave us a rough estimate of the project cost.
examples.target: 老師給了我們一個關於項目成本的大約估算。

examples.source: Can you give me a rough time when you will arrive?
examples.target: 你可以給我一個你大約到達的時間嗎？

examples.source: The surface of this wooden table is very rough.
examples.target: 這張木桌的表面非常粗糙。

examples.source: My hands feel rough because I did not wear gloves.
examples.target: 因為我沒有戴手套，所以我的雙手感覺很粗糙。

examples.source: The cat has a rough tongue when it licks me.
examples.target: 當貓咪舔我的時候，牠的舌頭感覺很粗糙。

examples.source: The sea was very rough, so we stayed on the boat.
examples.target: 海面非常波濤洶湧，所以我們留在船上。

examples.source: He had a rough time because he lost his school bag.
examples.target: 他因為弄丟了書包，所以過了一段艱難的日子。

examples.source: Please do not be rough when you play with the puppy.
examples.target: 當你和小狗玩耍時，請不要粗魯地對待牠。

round-the-clock.meaning: 全天候的 / 日以繼夜的

examples.source: The convenience store offers round-the-clock service for all customers.
examples.target: 這間便利店為所有顧客提供全天候服務。

examples.source: The hospital provides round-the-clock care for patients in the ward.
examples.target: 醫院為病房內的病人提供日以繼夜的護理。

examples.source: We worked round-the-clock to finish the project before the deadline.
examples.target: 我們日以繼夜地工作，以便在限期前完成計劃。

examples.source: Please sit in the front row so you can see better.
examples.target: 請坐在前排，這樣你可以看得清楚一點。

examples.source: There is a long row of trees outside our classroom window.
examples.target: 我們課室窗外有一排長長的樹。

examples.source: We stood in a row when we waited for the bus.
examples.target: 我們等巴士的時候排成了一行。

examples.source: The two brothers had a loud row about who should play.
examples.target: 兩兄弟因為誰應該玩遊戲而發生了激烈的爭吵。

examples.source: They had a row because they could not agree on dinner.
examples.target: 他們因為對晚餐吃什麼沒有共識而吵了一架。

examples.source: I do not want to have a row with my best friend.
examples.target: 我不想和最好的朋友發生爭吵。

examples.source: The royal family lives in a very large palace.
examples.target: 皇室成員住在一座非常大的宮殿裡。

examples.source: She wore a beautiful dress for the royal wedding.
examples.target: 她為那場皇室婚禮穿上了一件漂亮的裙子。

examples.source: The royal guards stand still when they are on duty.
examples.target: 當皇家衛兵執勤時，他們會站著一動也不動。

examples.source: The author receives a royalty for every book he sells.
examples.target: 作者每賣出一本書都會收到版稅。

examples.source: Many people gathered to see the members of the royalty.
examples.target: 許多人聚集在一起，希望能見到皇室成員。

examples.source: She wrote a song and now earns a royalty from it.
examples.target: 她寫了一首歌，現在正從中賺取版稅。

examples.source: My brother plays rugby at school every Saturday morning.
examples.target: 我哥哥每逢星期六早上都會在學校打欖球。

examples.source: Rugby is a popular sport because it is very exciting.
examples.target: 欖球是一項受歡迎的運動，因為它非常刺激。

examples.source: We watched a rugby match when we visited the stadium.
examples.target: 我們參觀體育館時，觀看了一場欖球比賽。

examples.source: The doctor did tests to rule out any serious illness.
examples.target: 醫生進行了檢查，以排除任何嚴重的疾病。

examples.source: We cannot rule out the possibility of rain tomorrow.
examples.target: 我們不能排除明天會下雨的可能性。

examples.source: Police ruled out the suspect because he has an alibi.
examples.target: 警方排除了該名嫌疑人，因為他有不在場證明。

examples.source: We ran out of milk, so I went to the shop.
examples.target: 我們用完了牛奶，所以我去了商店。

examples.source: Please tell me if you run out of paper today.
examples.target: 如果你今天用紙用完了，請告訴我。

examples.source: My phone will run out of battery very soon now.
examples.target: 我的手機很快就會耗盡電量了。

rush hour.meaning: 繁忙時間 / 交通高峰時間

examples.source: The roads are very crowded during the morning rush hour.
examples.target: 早上繁忙時間，路面非常擠塞。

examples.source: I always take the MTR to avoid the evening rush hour.
examples.target: 我總是乘搭港鐵，以避開傍晚的繁忙時間。

examples.source: It is difficult to find a taxi during rush hour.
examples.target: 在繁忙時間，很難截到的士。

examples.source: Russia is the largest country in the world by area.
examples.target: 俄羅斯是世界上領土面積最大的國家。

examples.source: Many people visit Russia to see its beautiful old buildings.
examples.target: 許多人去俄羅斯參觀那裡美麗的古老建築。

examples.source: I want to learn about the history and culture of Russia.
examples.target: 我想了解俄羅斯的歷史和文化。

examples.source: The ruthless boss fired everyone when the company lost money.
examples.target: 當公司虧錢時，那位無情的老闆解僱了所有人。

examples.source: It was ruthless of him to leave his friend behind.
examples.target: 他拋下朋友不管，真是太無情了。

examples.source: She made a ruthless decision to stop the failing project.
examples.target: 她做出了一個無情的決定，終止了那個失敗的項目。

examples.source: Our school promotes harmony and rejects all forms of racial discrimination.
examples.target: 我們學校提倡和諧，並拒絕任何形式的種族歧視。

examples.source: It is important to respect people from different racial and cultural backgrounds.
examples.target: 尊重來自不同種族和文化背景的人是非常重要的。

examples.source: The students held a discussion about racial equality in their social studies class.
examples.target: 學生們在通識課上討論了關於種族平等的議題。

examples.source: Our school has a strict policy against any form of racism.
examples.target: 我們學校有嚴格的規定，禁止任何形式的種族歧視。

examples.source: We should work together to stop racism in our daily lives.
examples.target: 我們應該共同努力，在日常生活中停止種族歧視。

examples.source: Learning about other cultures is a great way to fight racism.
examples.target: 了解其他文化是打擊種族歧視的好方法。

examples.source: It is wrong to make racist comments about people from other countries.
examples.target: 對來自其他國家的人發表種族歧視的言論是不對的。

examples.source: Our school has a strict policy against any form of racist behavior.
examples.target: 我們學校有嚴格的規定，禁止任何形式的種族歧視行為。

examples.source: We should treat everyone with respect and avoid using any racist language.
examples.target: 我們應該尊重每一個人，並且避免使用任何種族歧視的語言。

examples.source: It is wrong to be a racist and treat people unfairly based on race.
examples.target: 做一個種族歧視者並根據種族不公平地對待他人是錯誤的。

examples.source: The school has a strict policy against any student acting like a racist.
examples.target: 學校有嚴格的政策，禁止任何學生表現得像個種族歧視者。

examples.source: No one wants to be friends with a person who is a known racist.
examples.target: 沒有人想與一個眾所周知的種族歧視者做朋友。

examples.source: The scientists are studying the effects of radiation on our daily environment.
examples.target: 科學家們正在研究輻射對我們日常生活環境的影響。

examples.source: We should protect ourselves from too much radiation when using electronic devices.
examples.target: 我們在使用電子產品時，應該避免接觸過多的輻射。

examples.source: Some medical treatments use radiation to help patients recover from their illnesses.
examples.target: 一些醫療療程會利用輻射來幫助病人康復。

examples.source: Many people in Hong Kong travel to work by the MTR rail system.
examples.target: 香港有許多人乘搭港鐵系統上班。

examples.source: The government plans to build a new rail line to the airport.
examples.target: 政府計劃興建一條通往機場的新鐵路。

examples.source: We can take the high-speed rail to visit our relatives in China.
examples.target: 我們可以乘搭高鐵去探望在內地的親戚。

examples.source: We can take the rail to get to the city center quickly.
examples.target: 我們可以乘搭鐵路快速前往市中心。

examples.source: Please hold the hand rail tightly when you walk down the stairs.
examples.target: 走樓梯時請緊握扶手。

examples.source: The government plans to build a new rail line for the residents.
examples.target: 政府計劃為居民興建一條新的鐵路路線。

examples.source: Our school club wants to raise awareness of the importance of recycling.
examples.target: 我們學校學會希望提高大家對回收重要性的意識。

examples.source: This campaign aims to raise awareness of mental health among local teenagers.
examples.target: 這項活動旨在提高本地青少年對心理健康的意識。

examples.source: We should raise awareness of protecting endangered animals in our daily lives.
examples.target: 我們在日常生活中應該提高對保護瀕危動物的意識。

examples.source: You must consider every possible ramification before deciding to quit your school club.
examples.target: 在決定退出校隊之前，你必須考慮每一個可能的後果。

examples.source: Missing the final exam will have a serious ramification for your overall grade.
examples.target: 缺席期末考試會對你的總成績造成嚴重的影響。

examples.source: The new school policy has had a positive ramification on student attendance rates.
examples.target: 這項新的學校政策對學生的出席率產生了正面的影響。

examples.source: The teacher picked a random student to answer the question in class.
examples.target: 老師在課堂上隨機挑選了一位學生來回答問題。

examples.source: We decided to go on a random trip to the beach this weekend.
examples.target: 我們決定這個週末隨機去海灘遊玩。

examples.source: It is not a good idea to click on random links on the internet.
examples.target: 胡亂點擊網上的連結並不是一個好主意。

rank.meaning: 排名 / 把某事物排名

examples.source: The teacher decided to rank the students based on their final exam results.
examples.target: 老師決定根據學生的期末考試成績來為他們排名。

examples.source: Many people rank this restaurant as the best place to eat in town.
examples.target: 許多人將這間餐廳排名為城中最好的食肆。

examples.source: Our school ranks among the top three in the district for academic performance.
examples.target: 我們學校的學術表現排名全區前三名。

examples.source: She achieved the highest rank in the school's annual mathematics competition.
examples.target: 她在學校的年度數學比賽中獲得了最高名次。

examples.source: The captain holds a senior rank in the local police force.
examples.target: 那位隊長在當地的警隊中擁有高級職級。

examples.source: Our school team improved its rank after winning the final football match.
examples.target: 我們的校隊在贏得最後一場足球賽後提升了排名。

examples.source: The garden was overgrown with rank weeds after the long summer holiday.
examples.target: 經過漫長的暑假後，花園裡長滿了嚴重的雜草。

examples.source: He felt a rank sense of injustice when he was blamed for nothing.
examples.target: 當他無辜被責備時，他感到一種完全的不公平。

examples.source: The team suffered a rank failure because they did not prepare at all.
examples.target: 由於他們完全沒有準備，這支隊伍遭遇了嚴重的失敗。

examples.source: The teacher will rank the projects based on their creativity.
examples.target: 老師會根據創意為這些專題報告排名。

examples.source: The website ranks the books from most popular to least popular.
examples.target: 網站按受歡迎程度為書籍排名。

examples.source: This city is ranked as one of the best places to live.
examples.target: 這座城市被評為最適合居住的地方之一。

examples.source: He rose through the ranks to become the company manager.
examples.target: 他由基層員工晉升，最終成為公司經理。

examples.source: She joined the ranks of the city’s top athletes.
examples.target: 她躋身於這座城市頂尖運動員的行列。

examples.source: The new members were welcomed into the ranks of the club.
examples.target: 新成員受到歡迎，加入了學會的行列。

examples.source: The city has seen rapid growth in the number of new coffee shops.
examples.target: 這座城市的新咖啡店數量出現了迅速增長。

examples.source: We need to take rapid action to finish this group project on time.
examples.target: 我們需要採取迅速行動，才能準時完成這個小組習作。

examples.source: The rapid change in weather made it difficult to plan our outdoor trip.
examples.target: 天氣的快速轉變，令我們很難計劃戶外行程。

examples.source: The canoe moved quickly through the rapid.
examples.target: 獨木舟快速穿過急流。

examples.source: The guide told us about the rapid ahead.
examples.target: 導遊提醒我們前方有急流。

examples.source: A rapid can be dangerous after heavy rain.
examples.target: 大雨過後，急流可能很危險。

examples.source: The number of students in our school is growing rapidly every year.
examples.target: 我們學校的學生人數每年都在迅速增長。

examples.source: Technology is changing our daily lives quite rapidly in the modern world.
examples.target: 在現代社會，科技正非常快速地改變我們的日常生活。

examples.source: He finished his homework rapidly so he could go out to play.
examples.target: 他迅速地完成了功課，好讓自己可以出去玩。

examples.source: The students saw a rat running across the school playground this morning.
examples.target: 學生們今早看見一隻老鼠跑過學校操場。

examples.source: We must keep the kitchen clean to avoid attracting any rats indoors.
examples.target: 我們必須保持廚房清潔，以免引來老鼠進入屋內。

examples.source: My little brother was scared when he spotted a rat in the park.
examples.target: 我弟弟在公園發現一隻老鼠時感到非常害怕。

examples.source: The movie has a high rating because the story is very interesting.
examples.target: 這部電影的評分很高，因為故事非常有趣。

examples.source: Please give our service a rating after you finish your meal today.
examples.target: 請在今天用餐後，為我們的服務進行評分。

examples.source: This restaurant has a top rating among all the cafes in town.
examples.target: 這家餐廳在城中所有咖啡店裡的評級是最高的。

examples.source: The show received a high rating after its first week.
examples.target: 節目播出第一星期後取得高收視率。

examples.source: A strong rating helped the channel sell more adverts.
examples.target: 高收視率幫助電視頻道賣出更多廣告。

examples.source: The drama had the best rating of the month.
examples.target: 這套劇集取得本月最高收視率。

examples.target: 你不應該吃生魚，因為它可能含有害細菌。

examples.source: The factory uses raw materials to produce high quality plastic toys.
examples.target: 這間工廠使用原材料來生產高品質的塑膠玩具。

examples.source: Many people prefer eating raw vegetables to keep all the vitamins.
examples.target: 許多人喜歡吃生蔬菜，以保留所有的維他命。

examples.target: 這部紀錄片真實直接地呈現了城市裡的生活面貌。

examples.source: He shared his raw feelings about the pressure of the upcoming final exams.
examples.target: 他真實直接地表達了對即將到來的期末考試所感受到的壓力。

examples.source: The singer gave a raw performance that really touched everyone in the room.
examples.target: 這位歌手帶來了一場真實直接的表演，深深打動了在場的每一個人。

examples.source: You should not eat raw fish because it might contain harmful bacteria.
examples.target: 你不應該吃生魚，因為它可能含有害細菌。

examples.source: Make sure to wash the raw vegetables thoroughly before you start cooking.
examples.target: 在開始烹飪之前，請確保徹底清洗這些生蔬菜。

examples.target: 食譜上說這塊肉的中間部分還沒煮熟。

examples.target: 同學們終於就學校嘉年華的主題達成共識。

examples.target: 年輕人在尋求獨立的過程中出現反叛心理是很常見的。

examples.target: 這位年輕的反叛者拒絕遵守學校嚴格的服裝規定。

examples.target: 他決定辭去穩定的工作，這是對父母期望的一種反抗。

examples.source: Please ensure the name of the recipient is clearly written on the parcel.

examples.source: The reconstruction of the old library will be completed by next summer.

examples.target: 火災過後，這座城市開始重建受損的歷史街區。

examples.target: 目擊者開始向警方詳述意外發生的經過。

examples.target: 我祖父很喜歡講述他在鄉村度過的童年往事。

examples.source: She recounted how she overcame her fear of public speaking during the interview.
examples.target: 她在面試中詳述了自己是如何克服公開演講恐懼的。

examples.source: He sat by the fire and recounted his adventures in the mountains.
examples.target: 他坐在火爐旁，敘述他在山中的冒險經歷。

examples.source: The witness was asked to recount exactly what happened that night.
examples.target: 目擊者被要求詳細講述那天晚上發生的事情。

examples.source: She recounted the story of how she learned to play the piano.
examples.target: 她講述了自己是如何學會彈鋼琴的故事。

examples.source: The government decided to hold a referendum to let citizens vote on the new policy.
examples.target: 政府決定舉行全民投票，讓市民就新政策表態。

examples.target: 這次全民投票的結果將會決定該項目的未來。

examples.target: 許多人參與了這次公投，以表達他們對建議修訂的看法。

examples.target: 湖面上清晰地映照出群山的倒影。

examples.target: 考試過後，我們花了一些時間靜下來反思自己的錯誤。

examples.target: 老師鼓勵學生為他們的義工經歷寫一份反思報告。

examples.source: His decision to quit the team was the result of deep reflection.

examples.source: The school introduced a major reform to its curriculum this year.
examples.target: 學校今年對課程進行了重大改革。

examples.source: Many students support the proposed reform of the examination system.
examples.target: 許多學生都支持這項關於考試制度的改革建議。

examples.source: The government is planning a series of reforms to improve public services.
examples.target: 政府正計劃進行一系列改革，以改善公共服務。

examples.source: The school decided to reform its curriculum to better prepare students for the future.
examples.target: 學校決定改革課程，以便讓學生為未來做好更充分的準備。

examples.target: 他決心改掉壞習慣，開始過更健康的生活。

examples.target: 考古學家小心地挖掘出在該處發現的古代遺跡。

rip off.meaning: 敲詐 / 收取過高價錢

examples.target: 這首歌聽起來像抄襲了一首舊熱門歌。

examples.target: 不要剽竊另一位學生的文章。

examples.target: 設計師被指抄襲標誌。

examples.target: 這個計劃幫助年輕人脫離貧窮。

examples.target: 一間機械人科技初創公司到訪我們學校。

examples.target: 這間機械人科技初創公司製造了一部小型送貨機械人。

examples.target: 她希望在機械人科技初創公司工作。

roll out pastry.meaning: 擀開酥皮 / 擀開麵皮

examples.target: 切成圓形前，先擀開酥皮。

rome wasn't built in a day.meaning: 羅馬不是一天建成的 / 大事需要時間

rule someone out.meaning: 排除某人 / 令某人不能參加

examples.target: 體檢後，教練排除該球員參賽。

run for cover.meaning: 跑去躲避 / 逃往掩護處

examples.target: 下雨時，人們跑去躲避。

examples.target: 電影中，士兵逃往掩護處。

examples.target: 污水流走進河流。

run off the road.meaning: 迫離道路 / 被逼駛離路面

examples.target: 在學校發生衝突後，他們道歉。

rack up a hefty tab.meaning: 累積高額開支 / 花上一大筆錢

examples.target: 那組人晚餐累積高額開支。

examples.target: 網購可能令人花上一大筆錢。

examples.target: 維修工程累積了高額開支。

raring to go.meaning: 迫不及待想開始 / 精神奕奕準備好

examples.target: 比賽前，隊伍精神奕奕準備好。

examples.target: 早餐後，孩子們迫不及待想開始。

examples.source: She arrived early, raring to go.
examples.target: 她提早到達，精神奕奕準備好。

examples.source: Students raved about the new game.
examples.target: 學生大讚新遊戲。

examples.target: 評論熱烈稱讚這間餐廳。

examples.source: Everyone raved about her performance.
examples.target: 所有人都大讚她的表演。

ready-to-wear.meaning: 成衣的 / 可即買即穿的

examples.target: 商店售賣成衣裙子。

examples.source: Ready-to-wear clothes are not made for one person only.
examples.target: 成衣不是只為一個人訂造的。

examples.source: The designer launched a ready-to-wear collection.
examples.target: 設計師推出可即買即穿的系列。

examples.source: The class was receptive to new ideas.
examples.target: 全班容易接受新想法。

examples.source: She is receptive to feedback.
examples.target: 她容易接受回饋。

examples.target: 家長容易接受學校的計劃。

recipe for disaster.meaning: 災難的導火線 / 必定出事的情況

examples.target: 考試前不睡覺是必定出事的情況。

examples.target: 規劃不足加上惡劣天氣是災難的導火線。

examples.source: The new evidence made her reconsider her position.
examples.target: 新證據令她重新考慮立場。

examples.target: 問卷後，學校可能重新考慮立場。

examples.source: He refused to reconsider his position at first.
examples.target: 他起初拒絕重新考慮立場。

examples.target: 他們沒有訴諸懲罰就解決問題。

examples.source: The policy aims to rein in rising costs.
examples.target: 政策旨在控制上升成本。

remain to be seen.meaning: 仍有待觀察 / 尚未確定

examples.source: Whether the plan will work remains to be seen.
examples.target: 計劃是否有效仍有待觀察。

examples.source: It remains to be seen if students will like the new app.
examples.target: 學生會否喜歡新應用程式尚未確定。

examples.target: 長遠結果仍有待觀察。

rest on one's laurels.meaning: 滿足於既有成就 / 固步自封

results speak for themselves.meaning: 結果不言而喻 / 成效一目了然

retreat from the limelight.meaning: 退出公眾焦點 / 避開鎂光燈

right to disconnect.meaning: 下班後斷線權 / 拒收工後工作訊息的權利

rise through the ranks.meaning: 逐級晉升 / 晉升高位

rise to prominence.meaning: 變得重要 / 嶄露頭角

roll off the tongue.meaning: 說起來順口 / 容易上口

examples.source: Laughing at his mistake rubbed salt in his wounds.
examples.target: 嘲笑他的錯誤是在他傷口上撒鹽。

examples.source: Do not rub salt in someone's wounds after they lose.
examples.target: 別人在失敗後，不要令情況更難受。

examples.source: The extra fee rubbed salt in customers' wounds.
examples.target: 額外收費令顧客更難受。

rub salt into someone's wounds.meaning: 在傷口上灑鹽 / 令情況更難受

examples.source: The rude comment rubbed salt into her wounds.
examples.target: 無禮的評論在她傷口上灑鹽。

examples.source: Mentioning the score rubbed salt into the team's wounds.
examples.target: 提起比分令隊伍更難受。

examples.source: The delay rubbed salt into passengers' wounds.
examples.target: 延誤令乘客情況更難受。

rub someone up the wrong way.meaning: 惹惱某人 / 令人反感

examples.source: His rude tone rubbed the teacher up the wrong way.
examples.target: 他無禮的語氣惹惱了老師。

examples.source: The advert rubbed many viewers up the wrong way.
examples.target: 廣告令很多觀眾反感。

examples.source: Be careful not to rub clients up the wrong way.
examples.target: 小心不要惹惱客戶。

examples.source: The dictator ruled through force.
examples.target: 獨裁者以武力統治。

examples.source: The history chapter describes leaders who ruled through force.
examples.target: 歷史章節描述以武力統治的領袖。

examples.source: A society cannot stay fair if it is ruled through force.
examples.target: 如果社會以武力統治，就不能保持公平。

run in someone's blood.meaning: 是某人天生擅長 / 家族遺傳的

examples.source: Music seems to run in her blood.
examples.target: 音樂似乎是她天生擅長的。

examples.source: Teaching runs in his blood; both parents are teachers.
examples.target: 教學像是他的家族遺傳，父母都是老師。

examples.source: Sport runs in the family's blood.
examples.target: 運動是這個家庭天生擅長的事。

run up a tally.meaning: 累積一筆數目 / 累計金額

examples.source: The class ran up a tally of fifty books read.
examples.target: 全班累計讀了五十本書。

examples.source: The repairs ran up a tally of several thousand dollars.
examples.target: 維修累積了數千元開支。

examples.source: The charity event ran up a large donation tally.
examples.target: 慈善活動累積了一筆大額捐款。
